summary: DROP proposed (special-use-permit-only camping): the area page says 'Dispersed primitive camping is allowed only with a special use permit available from the Southwest Regional Office (417-895-6880)', lists Camping as 'Designated Camping Sites / Special Use Permit Required', and the brochure says 'Primitive camping is permitted with a special use permit.' The Grand Bluffs case.
flags: DROP (special use permit only): area page https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/little-sac-woods-conservation-area: 'Dispersed primitive camping is allowed only with a special use permit available from the Southwest Regional Office (417-895-6880).' Things to Do When You Visit: 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites, Special Use Permit Required'. Brochure https://mdc.mo.gov/sites/default/files/2024-06/7940.pdf: 'Primitive camping is permitted with a special use permit. Contact the Southwest Regional Office at (417) 895-6880.' Rule 140 on the page is the standard text. GIS 27 has two camping points (1039 = stored pin, 132 m from lot 1984; 1040, 1.0 km east, 0.6 km from lot 1985), but every night needs a permit applied for in advance - the 2026-11-09 'camping by special use permit only' rule (as Grand Bluffs).
If kept anyway: phone 'For more information call (417) 895-6880' matches stored; not waterfront ('A small segment of Little Sac River traverses the area, though access to the water is difficult').
